title: DetectXRv Kit Protocol
author: bkatchman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bkg4ktyw
materials: Zymo Research Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Kit
Before starting, thaw Buffer 2 at room temperature. You will need Buffer 1 as well SSC (20X), RNase-free Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM9770 Denhardt's Solution (50X) Thermo Fisher Catalog #750018
Aspirate Hybridization Cocktail from the plates
Exit the Array Reader application, select “Exit”.

steps.title: Place swab in VTM
steps.instruction: Place the nasopharyngeal swab into 400 µL – 2 mL of 1× viral transport medium (VTM) for storage prior to RNA extraction.

steps.title: Vortex and aliquot sample
steps.instruction: If the swab is in VTM, vortex for 10 seconds, then remove 400 µL for the Sample Preparation and DNA/RNA Purification procedures using the Zymo Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Kit.

steps.title: Store remaining sample
steps.instruction: Store any remaining VTM at –20 °C for up to two weeks or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Extract RNA with Zymo kit
steps.instruction: Extract RNA with the Zymo Research Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral MagBead Kit (catalog #R2140 or R2141) following the manufacturer’s instructions, using the ZR‑96 MagStand.

steps.title: Store extracted RNA
steps.instruction: Use the extracted RNA immediately or store frozen at –20 °C for up to two weeks or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare RT‑PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Mix and briefly centrifuge each component, then combine per reaction: 2 µL Access Quick Mastermix (2×), 1 µL RT‑PCR Primer Set 1 (1 µM), 5 µL AMV RT (5 U/µL, final 0.1 U/µL), and nuclease‑free water to bring the master mix to 45 µL (total reaction volume will be 50 µL after adding RNA). Multiply volumes according to the number of samples, omitting the RNA template.

steps.title: Dispense master mix to wells
steps.instruction: Pipette 45 µL of the prepared master mix into each well of the PCR plate.

steps.title: Add RNA template
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the purified RNA sample to each designated well, changing tips between samples.

steps.title: Seal and centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with clear adhesive film, seal, then centrifuge for 30 seconds using a PCR plate spinner.

steps.title: Run RT‑PCR program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a MiniAmp thermal cycler with a heat pad and run the following program: 45 °C 45 min (RT), 94 °C 2 min (RT inactivation), then 40 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 55 °C 30 s, 68 °C 30 s, followed by a final extension at 68 °C for 7 min.

steps.title: Prepare hybridization chamber
steps.instruction: Cut a paper towel to fit the bottom of the PathogenDx Hybridization Chamber (HYB‑001) and place the PCR plate (or slide) inside the chamber.

steps.title: Wash arrays with water
steps.instruction: Perform the initial water washes on each well of the 96‑well microarray slide.

substeps.instruction: Apply 200 µL molecular‑biology‑grade water to each well, avoiding contact with the array surface.
Dispense 200 µL water again, cover the chamber, and let sit for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑hybridization buffers
steps.instruction:
Prepare Pre‑hybridization Buffer and Hybridization Buffer for the number of microarrays to be processed (full 96‑well plate volumes):
• Pre‑hybridization Buffer: 16 761 µL water, 4 976 µL Buffer 1, 2 618 µL Buffer 2.
• Hybridization Buffer: 1 390 µL Buffer 1, 700 µL Buffer 2 (include 20 % extra). Vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Apply pre‑hybridization buffer
steps.instruction: Aspirate the water wash, then add 200 µL pre‑hybridization buffer to each well without touching the array surface; close the chamber lid.

steps.title: Incubate pre‑hybridization buffer
steps.instruction: Allow the pre‑hybridization buffer to remain on the arrays for 5 minutes; do not remove the slides from the chamber.

steps.title: Centrifuge labeling PCR product
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tubes or plate containing the labeling PCR product.

steps.title: Create hybridization cocktail
steps.instruction: Add 18 µL Hybridization Buffer to each well containing the labeling PCR product, pipette up and down to mix. This mixture is the Hybridization Cocktail.

steps.title: Add cocktail to arrays
steps.instruction: Aspirate the pre‑hybridization buffer from the arrays (do not let them dry), then immediately add 68 µL of the Hybridization Cocktail to each well, avoiding tip contact with the array surface. Record sample ID and well location.

steps.title: Hybridize slides
steps.instruction: Close the chamber lid and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes. Keep the chamber stationary to prevent sample merging.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Buffer for the number of slides (full 96‑well plate): 777.6 µL Buffer 1, 102.9 mL molecular‑biology‑grade water, total 103.7 mL.

steps.title: Perform sequential washes
steps.instruction: Execute the following wash steps quickly to avoid drying:

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Add 200 µL Wash Buffer, mix 5 times, aspirate.
Wash 2: Add 200 µL Wash Buffer, mix 5 times, aspirate.
Wash 3: Add 200 µL Wash Buffer, mix 5 times, let sit 5 min, aspirate.
Wash 4: Add 200 µL Wash Buffer, mix 5 times, let sit 5 min, aspirate.
Wash 5: Add 200 µL Wash Buffer, mix 5 times, let sit 5 min, aspirate.
Final wash: Dispense and aspirate 200 µL Wash Buffer twice rapidly.

steps.title: Dry slides in centrifuge
steps.instruction: Load the slides into a plate centrifuge and spin for 1 minute to completely dry the wells.

steps.title: Store slides before scanning
steps.instruction: Place the dried plates back into a moisture‑barrier bag with desiccant, protect from light, and scan within two weeks of hybridization.

steps.title: Load slides into scanner
steps.instruction: Open the Sensovation scanner software (Array Reader), open the tray, and place the slides with the barcode facing the technician and face down (for a 96‑well plate, face up and align A1 top‑left). Close the tray.

steps.title: Configure scanner settings
steps.instruction: From the dropdown menu select “12‑well slide – PDx, 96‑well – PDx”. Do not alter any other pre‑programmed settings.

steps.title: Start scanning
steps.instruction: Press the Blue Arrow to begin scanning.

steps.title: Exit scanner and retrieve slides
steps.instruction: When the digital image with all green wells appears, click the Red X, open the tray, remove the slides, and store them in the slide case inside the moisture‑barrier bag with desiccant.

steps.title: Rename scan results folder
steps.instruction: On the scanner desktop, open the “Scan Results” folder, locate the folder for your slide, and rename it to the barcode number (e.g., rename ScanJob‑191108130334_1 to 7024001001).

steps.title: Upload images for analysis
steps.instruction: Submit the renamed barcode‑labeled folder to the “Image Folder” in Dropbox; the PathogenDx Augury© software will automatically upload, analyze, and deposit reports into the “Reports” folder.
